source: official Rakuten Travel data spec (data_spec_20251125.txt) + arXiv Nakayama et al., 'Rakuten Data Release'
note: Authoritative column->aspect mapping per the official spec. Corrects an earlier off-by-one error where fields[9] (overall_rating) was mistaken for 総合 and rating_6 (fields[15]) was labelled 立地. Cross-validated: (1) official spec column order; (2) P0-3 model verification matched rating_1..5 exactly (部屋/食事/風呂/サービス/設備), see panel_rating_column_map.model_verification.json; (3) numeric check: rating_6 has the highest correlation with the mean of the other columns (0.825) => it is 総合, while overall_rating (立地) has the lowest (0.495).
